# Henneth

> A scheduled research and analytics desk covering the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) in depth,
> with global index and sector context. It publishes plain-English company reads, backtested
> strategies, model fair value, and analyst debates that are dated and scored over time — losses
> included. It is educational research tooling, not an investment adviser: it gives no
> personalised advice, issues no buy/sell/hold ratings or price targets on named securities, and
> places no orders. Currently in free early access; there is no charge and no checkout.

Two properties: the marketing site at https://henneth.app (public, indexable, everything linked
below) and the members-only terminal at https://desk.henneth.app (account required).

House rules that constrain everything published: long-only, daily timeframe, every price and date
comes from the desk's own data layer rather than from memory, and no advice language. Under SECP
Reg 2(ha) the desk does not publish a directional call, price target or stop-loss on a named
security — the analyst debate is published, the verdict is not.

## Start here

- [Home](https://henneth.app/): what the desk is and who it is for.
- [Features](https://henneth.app/features/): what the terminal actually does.
- [Plans](https://henneth.app/plans/): current access terms. Free early access, no payment.
- [About](https://henneth.app/about/): explain, debate, keep score — the three commitments.
- [Pricing, machine-readable](https://henneth.app/pricing.md): the same access terms as a
  parseable file.

## PSX company data

- [PSX companies](https://henneth.app/psx/): the hub. One public page per covered company —
  sector, index membership, liquidity, market cap, P/E, dividend yield, dividend record, and how
  far the desk's valuation methods disagree with each other on that name.

- [Blog](https://henneth.app/blog/): explainers on PSX market structure and method.

- [Research](https://henneth.app/research/): the desk's published output and how it is scored,
  including the same yardstick turned on Pakistani brokers' public calls.

## Free calculators

No account needed. Each runs entirely in the browser.

- [All calculators](https://henneth.app/tools/)
- [Position size calculator](https://henneth.app/tools/position-size-calculator/): the desk's own
  risk-per-trade sizing rule, not a generic one.
- [Strategy level calculator](https://henneth.app/tools/strategy-level-calculator/)
- [Compound interest](https://henneth.app/tools/compound-interest-calculator/)

## Comparisons

- [Compare PSX research tools](https://henneth.app/compare/psx-research-tools/): a dated, source-linked guide to the different jobs done by market-data, screening, trading and research tools. Henneth is included and disclosed.

## Optional

- [Global markets](https://henneth.app/global-markets/): the US and global index/sector-ETF
  coverage that provides context for the PSX work.
- [Financial astrology](https://henneth.app/financial-astrology/): a tested, scored lens. The
  desk's own backtest ran 2,589 hypotheses and found zero survivors after correction, and the page
  publishes that null result. The lens never generates or gates a trade setup.
